Date : --29.04.2025 Heard Mr. D. Saikia, learned Advocate General, Assam assisted by Mr. B. Gogoi,
learned Additional Advocate General, for the State respondent.
Also heard Mr. D. J. Das, learned counsel appearing for the petitioner.
Mr. D. Saikia, learned Advocate General, Assam submits that an affidavit in opposition has been filed yesterday in WP(C)/2137/2025 and WP(C)/2135/2025.
Page No.# 3/3 Mr. D. Saikia, learned Advocate General, Assam seeks one week time to file rejoinder against the aforesaid affidavit in opposition.
